title: 因果掩码正确性验证（上三角 −inf → softmax 后 0）
expected_output:
上三角(未来)掩码数: 6
被掩位置 A 值(应全为0): [0. 0. 0. 0. 0. 0.]
被掩位置==0: True
每行和=1: [1. 1. 1. 1.]
code:
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
T = 4
d = 4
x = rng.standard_normal((T, d))
Wq = rng.standard_normal((d, d)); Wk = rng.standard_normal((d, d))
Q = x @ Wq; K = x @ Wk
scores = Q @ K.T
mask = np.triu(np.ones((T, T)), k=1).astype(bool)
masked = np.where(mask, -np.inf, scores)
def softmax(z):
    m = np.max(z, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    e = np.exp(z - m)
    return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
A = softmax(masked)
print("上三角(未来)掩码数:", int(mask.sum()))
print("被掩位置 A 值(应全为0):", np.round(A[mask], 6))
print("被掩位置==0:", bool(np.all(A[mask] == 0.0)))
print("每行和=1:", np.round(A.sum(axis=1), 6))
